preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s) and 1 <= n <= 5e5 and 1 <= k <= 5e5
preconditions.description: The input string `s` consists of lowercase English letters, and integers `n` (length of `s`) and `k` are within the bounds 1 ≤ n, k ≤ 5·10^5.
The length of the string `s` exactly matches the given integer `n`.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly length `k`.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output string is present in the original string `s` (i.e., it can be obtained by deletions and duplications).

postconditions.expression: not any(stdout[:i] == other[:i] and stdout[i] > other[i] for i in range(min(len(stdout), len(other))) for other in possible_strings(s, k))
postconditions.description: The output string is lexicographically smallest among all possible strings of length `k` obtainable by any sequence of deletions and duplications from `s`.
